name: Lattice
summary: Employee performance and engagement management with AI.
description: Lattice combines performance reviews, goals, feedback, engagement surveys and HR management. Its AI summarizes feedback, helps managers write reviews and surfaces team trends.

howToUse.title: Sign up on Lattice
howToUse.description: Create an account at the official URL if you need saved work or billing.

howToUse.title: Complete onboarding
howToUse.description: Follow the product tour or connect the first integration it asks for.

howToUse.title: Run a first task
howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

howToUse.title: Review outputs
howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.

features_fr: Aide à la rédaction des évaluations
summary_fr: Gestion de la performance et de l'engagement des employés, avec IA.
description_fr: Lattice réunit entretiens d'évaluation, objectifs, feedback, enquêtes d'engagement et gestion RH. Son IA résume les retours, aide les managers à rédiger les évaluations et repère les tendances dans l'équipe.
